from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single financial asset entry extracted from a document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    asset_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the financial asset line item, e.g., '使用权资产'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the asset")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of balance, e.g., '期末余额', '期初余额'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialAssetRecord]
